texts.zh: 我们伟大的[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]为国鞠躬尽瘁，享年[From.GetAge]岁。人们高呼，为了纪念这位领袖对[Root.GetName]的贡献，要举办一场盛大的追思仪式。这一盛事能将民众团结在一起，巩固我们的理念。
texts.en: Our great [From.GetTitle] [From.GetName] has passed away at the age of [From.GetAge] while in service to our empire. The people clamor for a memorial service to honor this leader's contribution to the [Root.GetName]. A grand event will give everyone closure, and bolster our ideals.

label.zh: 一场私人葬礼就足够了。

label.en: [From.GetHeSheCap] did nothing to deserve such honors.

label.zh: 规划一场盛大的追悼游行。马上。
以[From.GetHisHer]的名义设立一个基金。
label.en: Set up a foundation in [From.GetHisHer] name.

label.zh: 建立一座适合的纪念碑。
一场小规模的悼念会就足够了。
以[From.GetHisHer]的名字命名一个地标。

label.en: [From.GetHisHerCap] story does not have to end here...
The [Root.GetRulerTitle] wishes to consume the Honored one.
The [Root.GetRulerTitle] wishes to consume the Honored one.
The [Root.GetRulerTitle] wishes to consume the Honored one.

tooltips.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] will consume [From.GetName], gaining a new trait.

label.en: The [Root.GetRulerTitle] wishes to consume the Honored one.

tooltips.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] will consume [From.GetName], completing half of the current ['concept_agenda'].

texts.zh: [From.GetName]在最亲近的亲属和同事的环绕中静静地沉眠。其对[Root.GetName]的贡献不菲，但现在并不是能铺张浪费的时候。
texts.en: [From.GetName] is laid to rest in a private ceremony with their closest family members and colleagues. Their contribution to the [Root.GetName] was an important one, but now is not the time for exorbitant expenditure.

texts.zh:
在长长的游行队伍中，[From.GetName]静静地沉眠，[Root.GetName]的每一位公民都受邀前来表示敬意。

葬礼之后是为期一周的盛大祭典，祭典花费巨大。[From.GetName]的透明水晶棺材在[Root.Capital.GetName]纪念堂展出。人群排在街头，想要一睹他们伟大领袖的最终安息之处。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] has been laid to rest following a public procession. Every citizen of [Root.GetName] was invited to pay their respects.

The funeral is followed by a week-long festival, with no expenses spared. [From.GetName]'s translucent crystal casket is displayed at the [Root.Capital.GetName] memorial site, where the crowds line the streets hoping to catch a glimpse of the great leader in their final resting place.

texts.zh: 我们对[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]的谨慎处置被媒体迅速捕捉到了。尽管一些人表达了担忧，但许多消息来源还是坚定地指出了这位领袖的缺点。当前的普遍看法是，我们终于可以找一位更合适的继任者来替代现在这位领袖了。
texts.en: The discreet disposal of our [From.GetTitle], [From.GetName], has been promptly noted by the press. While others express concern, many sources adamantly point out the leader's shortcomings. The general sentiment is relief that we can now replace this leader with a more fitting successor.

label.en: It is time to move on.

texts.zh:
在一场简短的追悼会后，[From.GetTitle]的遗体被捐赠给了科学界，以对基础医药研究和教育继续做贡献。

这些过程中剩下的东西最终将被水火化，变成富含矿物质的肥料，确保身体的任何部分都不会被浪费。
texts.en:
After a brief commemoration, the [From.GetTitle]'s body has been donated to science to contribute towards essential medical research and education.

What is left from these procedures will in the end be water cremated and turned into a mineral-rich fertilizer, ensuring no part of the body goes to waste.

label.en: Such is the cycle of life.

texts.zh:
人们聚集在一起，追悼[From.GetName]的一生及其丰功伟绩。人们挤满了街道，向东望不见头，向西望不见尾。颂歌一直唱到了夜幕降临。[From.GetHeSheCap]现在已经跨入彼岸。

[From.GetHisHer]的布道节选现在在整个帝国回荡，提醒着我们共同的目标。
texts.en:
The people gathered in their masses to celebrate the life and career of [From.GetName]. Huge processions filled the streets, and hymns were sung long into the night. [From.GetHeSheCap] is now waiting for us on the other side of the veil.

Popular excerpts from [From.GetHisHer] sermons are now reverberating across the empire, reminding us of our common goal.

texts.zh:
大型阅兵方阵和舰队护卫着[From.GetName]的灵柩前往最终安息之地。[From.GetHisHerCap]的遗体被发射去了最近的恒星，并全程向全社会广播。

逝世领袖的个人战略部署和日志成为了下一批军校学员课程中的内容。
texts.en:
A huge parade of troops and a flyover by naval forces marked the arrival of [From.GetName]'s casket to its final resting place. [From.GetHisHerCap] body was fired into the nearest star during a society-wide broadcast.

The departed leader's personal strategies and log books will become a part of the curriculum for the next generation of cadets.

texts.zh: 为了纪念刚刚去世的伟大[From.GetTitle]，[From.GetName]，我们设立了一个非盈利的基金会。这个基金会标志着星际的和平与和谐发展迈出了一步，包容了不同社群和物种之间的分歧。
texts.en: A non-profit foundation has been established to honor the passing of the great [From.GetTitle], [From.GetName]. The foundation marks a step towards peace and interstellar harmony, bridging differences between communities and species.

label.zh: 我们共同创造了一项遗产。

texts.zh:
当[From.GetName]去世的消息传遍更远的地区时，一种深深的悲痛笼罩了整个帝国。无数的哀悼者遵循传统的葬礼仪式加入了[Root.Capital.GetName]的葬礼队伍中。

其遗体被一丝不苟地清洁并进行了适当的装饰。在[From.GetTitle]的遗体进行了安葬之前，我们全国上下都要默哀，表示尊重。
texts.en:
A deep sorrow has gripped the public as news regarding the passing of [From.GetName] spreads to the wider community. Countless mourners join the funeral procession on [Root.Capital.GetName] to follow the traditional funeral rites.

The body is meticulously cleansed and appropriately decorated. Before the deceased [From.GetTitle] is laid to rest, a moment of silence is observed throughout our systems as a mark of respect.

texts.zh:
为纪念[From.GetName]一生的丰功伟绩，我们为[From.GetHimHer]准备了一场穿越星海的最后航行。

一个容纳着[From.GetTitle]遗体的胶囊被庄严地发射向未探索的宇域，伴随他的还有诗歌、图表、录音和其他贵宾带来的随葬品。将来有一天，[From.GetTitle]的船只可能会在那里找到一个新家，完成[From.GetHisHer]的最后任务。
texts.en:
The remarkable deeds of [From.GetName] have warranted [From.GetHimHer] one last voyage through space.

A capsule containing the [From.GetTitle]'s remains is ceremonially launched into the void alongside poems, charts, recordings, and other memorabilia brought by various dignitaries. One day the [From.GetTitle]'s vessel may find a new home out there, completing [From.GetHisHer] final mission.

texts.zh: 工匠们获得最好的材料来制作[From.GetName]的肖像，将其加入到[Root.GetName]传奇英雄的行列中。其庄严的面孔被蚀刻在石头和金属上，让人们牢记这位强大领袖的丰功伟绩。
texts.en: Artisans have been provided with the finest materials to fashion the likeness of [From.GetName], adding them to the long line of storied heroes of the [Root.GetName]. Their majestic visage is etched in stone and metal, acting as a reminder of what strong leaders can accomplish.

label.zh: 您的伟大将被永远铭记。

texts.zh: [From.GetName]的名字与头衔被镌刻在了一座高大耸立的纪念碑上，与无数其他为[Root.GetName]的人民鞠躬尽瘁的人们并列。这位备受尊敬的[From.GetTitle]将被人民永远铭记，他的贡献为未来数代领袖们开拓道路。
texts.en: [From.GetName]'s name and title are carved on a towering monument alongside others who have served the [Root.GetName] for the good of its population. The respected [From.GetTitle] will be fondly remembered by the people, paving the way for future generations of leaders.

label.en: For the good of the many.

texts.zh:
这位领袖的去世引起了星际证交所短暂但剧烈的震荡。

除了举办奢华的葬礼，[Root.GetName]还将一座较高的摩天楼重命名为[From.GetName]大厦以确保以后这位[From.GetTitle]的名字会被写入公司的编年史中。每间会议室的墙上都挂着一幅经过艺术诠释的肖像，以纪念其对帝国的杰出贡献。
texts.en:
News of the leader's passing is met with a sharp, but brief downturn in share value at the galactic stock markets.

In addition to sponsoring the lavish funeral, [Root.GetName] rebrands one of its taller skyscrapers as the [From.GetName] Building to ensure that the late [From.GetTitle]'s name is preserved in the annals of the corporate history. An artistically interpreted portrait is also hung on every boardroom wall to commemorate their outstanding contributions to the empire.

texts.zh:
[From.Species.GetName]的去世并不像表面上看起来那么彻底。尽管躯干已经开始劣化，但核心还可以恢复活力。

在浸泡过一种特殊的激素溶液后，[From.GetName]的遗体被小心翼翼地埋入[burial_planet.GetName]的土壤中。埋葬地由孵化者精心照料，他们耐心地等待幼体破土发芽，开始新的循环。
texts.en:
The death of a [From.Species.GetName] is not as final as it appears. Even if the main stem has begun to deteriorate, the roots can be reinvigorated.

After soaking in a special hormone solution, [From.GetName]'s remains are carefully buried in the soil of [burial_planet.GetName]. The burial site is tended by brood members who patiently await for younglings to sprout on the surface, starting the cycle anew.

label.en: From one life to the next.

texts.zh: [From.GetTitle][From.GetName]的意识在[From.GetAge]岁时从集体意识中移除。我们是[Root.GetName]，我们将永存。
texts.en: The mind of [From.GetTitle] [From.GetName] was removed from the collective at the age of [From.GetAge]. We are the [Root.GetName]. We will endure.

texts.zh:
[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]在可靠地服务了[From.GetYearsOfService]后发生了故障，彻底报废。我们的科学家已经备份了文件以保留重要数据。

基于[From.GetName]的智能全息图谱已经被安装在我们的舰船系统中，作为虚拟顾问为我们服务。他们将继续支援我们的任务。
texts.en:
[From.GetTitle] [From.GetName] has broken down after [From.GetYearsOfService] of reliable service. Our scientists have backed up their files to preserve important data.

An intelligent hologram based on [From.GetName] has been installed in our ship systems to serve as a virtual advisor. They will continue to aid in our mission.

label.zh: 死亡不再是一项障碍了。
label.en: Death is no longer an obstacle.

summary.text:
# 一位伟大领袖之死 / Death of a Great Leader

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/paragon_events.txt:2792-3990; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt (on_leader_death) · DLC: Paragon · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

领袖死亡时（on_leader_death），隐藏事件 paragon.549 检查（需 Paragon DLC，或帝国化的演化捕食者；领袖服役≥2年、非使者/非大可汗、技能≥4或是统治者或为知名/传奇）。随机表中“什么都不做”权重为80，葬礼权重从0起按领袖重要度累加（统治者+1000，议员/知名/传奇领袖、高技能、长服役各自加权，服役100年以上+300）；近期办过葬礼则“什么都不做”权重乘5。

When a leader dies (on_leader_death) hidden paragon.549 checks (Paragon DLC, or an imperial Evolutionary Predator; the leader served >=2 years, is not an envoy or Great Khan, and has skill >=4 or is the ruler or a renowned/legendary leader). In the random list "do nothing" weighs 80 while the funeral weight starts at 0 and grows with importance (ruler +1000; councilor, renowned/legendary, high skill and long service each add weight, 100+ years +300); a funeral in the last five years multiplies the "do nothing" weight by 5.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

按帝国与领袖类型选一个窗口（if/else）：非集群帝国——paragon.550“一位伟大领袖之死”；蜂巢——paragon.571“…永存”（5年“蜂巢/荒野永存”修正）；领袖物种为机器/机械的集群帝国——paragon.570“死亡驱役”（5年虚拟顾问修正）；其余情形无窗口。paragon.550 从若干葬礼中让玩家选择，并给出相应的修正或花费能量。

One window by empire and leader type (if / else): non-gestalt - paragon.550 "Death of a Great Leader"; hive - paragon.571 "The ... Endures" (5-year hive/wilderness endures modifier); gestalt with a robot/machine leader species - paragon.570 "Servitude in Death" (5-year virtual advisors modifier); otherwise no window. paragon.550 lets the player pick one of several funerals, each with its own modifier and energy cost.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

选项互斥，并由领袖标记决定是否出现：b 私密葬礼（始终可选，paragon.552）；a 公开葬礼（统治者必有，其他随机，费用高，paragon.551）；c 负面特质（paragon.553）；d 唯物（554）；e 灵性（555）；f 军国（556，费用中）；g 和平（557，费用中）；h 排外（558，费用低）；i 亲外（559，费用低）；j 威权（560，费用中）；k 平等（561）；l 公司（562，费用中）；m 植物/真菌（563）；另有4个“演化捕食者”吃掉统治者的选项。

The options are exclusive and gated by leader flags: b private funeral (always, paragon.552); a public funeral (always for rulers, otherwise random, high cost, paragon.551); c negative traits (553); d materialist (554); e spiritualist (555); f militarist (556, medium cost); g pacifist (557, medium); h xenophobe (558, low); i xenophile (559, low); j authoritarian (560, medium); k egalitarian (561); l megacorp (562, medium); m plantoid/fungoid (563); plus four Evolutionary Predator "eat the ruler" options.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

至多4个选项出现（私密、必要时公开、再随机补足到总数3–4个）；伦理类选项还要求领袖或帝国持有对应伦理。

At most about four options show (private, public when needed, then random extras up to the limit); ethic options also need the leader or empire to hold that ethic.
